item.text: The Corruption and Crime Commission investigated concerns about compliance with cattle identification and movement rules at Murdoch University.
item.support: The Commission commenced an investigation following reports of Mr Thomas' non-compliance with biosecurity requirements in relation to the identification and movement of cattle.

item.text: The Commission formed an opinion of serious misconduct about the livestock manager's use of university cattle for personal benefit and to assist private cattle studs.
item.support: The Commission has formed an opinion of serious misconduct by Mr Thomas.

item.text: The Commission concluded that weak governance, poor record controls and inadequate audits allowed deception to remain undetected and put biosecurity at risk.
item.support: Mr Thomas's deception remained uncovered for years due to the lack of proper governance surrounding the Murdoch University farms.
